sourceChecks.text: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ここはマナセの子らの系譜を述べる祖先個人の用法。部族カードの同一人物としては扱わず、同一ID内の個人context候補として別途確認が必要。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補IDの個人への対応を本文から確認できず、除外または保留。

sourceChecks.text: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

sourceChecks.text: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文の該当名/明確な関係を確認。

profileDecisionJa: ルベン族とガド族に続いて、マナセ半部族から戦士が数えられています。

wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Tribe of Manasseh
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Tribe of Manasseh 134行：マナセ族をイスラエル十二部族の一つと説明。157–160行：東西の半部族と領域を説明。
wikipediaReadEvidence.supportJa: 記事はマナセ族という集団を主題とし、東西二つの半部族にも触れる。初出の1歴代誌5:18は半部族の戦士集団を記す。
